BiblicalUsage: Jozachar is named once, in 2 Kings 12:21. In 2 Kings 12:21 we read, "For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jozachar is written down once, and I take that as proof God counts individuals.
